# Paul Rusu

> Paul Rusu (Rusu Adrian Paul) is a senior full-stack developer based in Zalău, Romania, with 10+ years of experience building web platforms end to end. He works remotely and is open to new full-time roles.

He works across the whole stack: React, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, Java/Spring, PostgreSQL, AWS and self-hosted infrastructure. He leads engineering for clients from first idea to production, modernizes legacy systems without disrupting the business, and uses AI-assisted development backed by testing and code review. He has worked with 10+ clients on 20+ projects across 5+ countries, on features used by more than 1M users.

## Experience

- [Senior Web Developer, We as Web (Jun 2024 – present)](https://paulrusu.ro/cv.html): contract work for a global sports betting and gaming group; high-traffic customer pages, internal promotion and user management tools, consent flows, migrations to Spring and React
- [Full-Stack Developer & Technical Consultant (May 2021 – present)](https://paulrusu.ro/cv.html): independent work including imobiliare.ro, web3 applications and event-driven apps on AWS
- [Senior Developer & Technical Lead, StarChain Solutions (Dec 2021 – Feb 2024)](https://paulrusu.ro/cv.html): led a cross-functional team; web3 integrations for games by Animoca Brands
- [Web Developer, 3Pillar Global (Nov 2018 – May 2021)](https://paulrusu.ro/cv.html): search and media platforms for clients including LexisNexis and Fortune
- [Earlier roles, Pitech Plus and HSDS (2016 – 2018)](https://paulrusu.ro/cv.html): UI development and a hotel revenue management application

## Projects

- [Hyper](https://paulrusu.ro/#work): ERP back office, multi-vendor marketplace and storefront for Romanian businesses; runs as a multi-tenant SaaS or as a white-label deployment per client
- [Cazare Mihaieni](https://cazaremihaieni.ro): bilingual booking website for holiday cottages, live and bringing in direct bookings
